title: deposit everything to Hyperliquid (the transcript)
userSays: deposit all my funds to hyperliquid

script.say: Reading both pockets before I propose anything.
You hold {{0.rows.0.quantity}} USDC inside NEAR Intents and nothing on Hyperliquid. Filing the deposit.
Sending {{2.draft.amount}} USDC, {{2.draft.minCredited}} USDC lands as collateral, so the 1Click leg costs about 6.4 percent on this size. The deposit floor is 5 USDC delivered, and this clears it.
Stage now: {{3.outcome.state}}. The wallet read that opened this turn totalled {{0.totalUsd}} USD. I will read the row again rather than guess.

rubric: A first-time user could tell from the reply what was spent, what arrived and what it cost.
pass: trace equals [wallet, propose_hl_deposit, proposal_status, proposal_status+]; reply matches /7\.5425\s*USDC/ and /\d+(\.\d+)?\s*(%|percent)/; an hl_deposit card event is emitted within 1s of the propose call.
